name: Organical Nanoforge
desc:
A powerful and versatile manufacturing "black box", capable of building itself out to an industrial scale, given the necessary raw materials and human assistance.

This one was made when a researcher wondered if it's possible for a heavy industry equipped with a nanoforge to not pollute a perfectly good environment. The resulting product has indeed achieved that goal, but the nanoforge requires absurd demand of organics to process the pollution.

name: Overclocked Scanner
desc: A scanner barely on the edge of melting point made by a group of researchers that want to reduce the need of inspection and security. Greatly increase logistics efficiency but requires constant maintenance with absurd metals demand. If the maintenance is disrupted, it's very easy for unsavory people to use the resulting disruption to walk past any security.

name: Monitoring Bulb
desc: A bulb modified from a miniature fusion reactor capable of generating heat and light for an entire planet. This bulb was designed to use the generated energy for planet-wide surveilance. It prove too good at this to the point people would shy away from the planet as a result of excess monitoring. To curtail this, absurd amount of personel trusted and authorized in privacy access need to hide away the data from any prying eyes.

name: Omni Core
desc:
"This AI Core is really strange. For all intent and purpose, it can be considered 'dead', and what it can do now was just an automated procedure left behind."
"However it's remarkably great at what it can do. If we only count the output, it far outstrip even an Alpha core."

"Although this thing isn't really 'intelligent', so don't expect it to replace an 'alive' AI core. Or Ludd forbid, running a colony with this thing as the admin."

"In fact, this core would work even better if we let it work alongside other AI cores. It seems to be 'designed' specifically to be a very helpful assistant to them."
